title: Split party on the map and on the road
summary: Each group of a split party has its own map marker, Here list, journeys and ship passage.
items: The map shows one marker per group, with its letter and colour, and Here lists what each group can use.
A journey moves one group; each group can have one journey, and one approval can move every group the DM ticks.
Arriving groups are moved in with Move <group> here, and a stable's coach carries the paying character's group.
A whole group can board a ship together and stay in the party.
